name: DevastatingTKL Keyboard
sourceText:
DevastatingTKL
Inspired by Brutalist architecture, designed by CannonKeys
The DevastatingTKL is a TKL layout CNC aluminum keyboard in our Brutalist Series of in stock keyboards. This keyboard is available in WK or WKL layout. The solderable PCB included is QMK/VIA supported and USB-C. The mounting style is a slightly modified top mount called burger mount. It takes the evenness from top mount and uses o-rings on the mounting screws to make the typing experience slightly less harsh.
At a glance
TKL layout burger mounted Keyboard
Black FR4 universal layout plate
DevastatingTKL Solderable PCB
7.5 ° typing angle
CNC aluminum case
20mm front height
Aprx 1.6kg without plate/PCB/switches
What's included
DevastatingTKL WK or WKL aluminum keyboard
Black FR4 plate in 6.25u layout (WK) or 7u layout (WKL)
DevastatingTKL solderable PCB
CannonKeys hard foam carrying case
Hardware
Bumpons (if you lose them, you can purchase replacements here )
Polyfill
Colors Available
Silver, Green, Navy, Lilac, Blurple, Black, Rose Gold, Aqua, and Nantucket Red
Addons Available
Extra Solderable PCB
Extra Universal and 7u plates
Universal plate layout
PCB support
Quality Disclaimer
In order to meet our goal of providing an in stock mid range keyboard at an affordable price, we have adjusted our quality standards compared to our more premium keyboards. We have listed acceptable blemishes and B-Stock information below.
The DevastatingTKL is a board aimed to stay within a budget, and maintain affordability. It's fully aluminum and anodized beautifully, but to achieve this price point, the quality bar is lower than some of our more "premium line" boards, such as the Satisfaction75 and Chimera65. Customers have been happy with the quality of the Brutal-line boards, but we like to communicate this prior to purchase.
In general, large defects to visible faces will make a board B stock. But minor issues, small issues that are only visible in just the right angle of lighting, or small dents or blemishes on the bottom of the case that are not visible when the keyboard is fully built and on the desk will not cause a B stock evaluation.
Keyboard cases that ship with keyboards are meant to protect keyboards during shipping. These keyboard cases are made to order to fit the keyboard precisely, and are limited in quantity. As such, we do not replace keyboard cases if the keyboard case arrives damaged. Ideally, no keyboard carrying case arrives damaged, but at times, couriers are rough with packages and damages can occur. In these instances, we offer customers a $5 coupon off their next order as compensation.

name: AEBoards Naevy Tactile Switch R1.5 (35)

specs.stemMaterial: MPE tactile stem - Custom mixed PE - A proprietary MPE

sourceText:
Naevy R1.5 Tactile Switch by AEBoards.
View the complete AEBoards Switch Lineup
The Naevy switch project has been a year of continual research and development into tactile switches. The current tactile switch market has been stagnant, without any innovation and most tactile builds require acquisition of multiple switches to be put together - increasing over cost, waste and effort.
The aim of the Naevy switch is to create a new type of tactile - affordable and good as a stock switch. We are still in early days of where we want to be for the ultimate tactile but we believe that have something available to the market that you’ll love - a smooth, great new tactile feeling. Bottoms out a little bit earlier and moves the bump to mid/mid-top
The stem is an original mold owned by AEBoards and uses a panda derivative housing (most commonly used for tactile switch modding). It is best described as a tactile stem—MX Clear-like bump with an extended pole. These stems have a different bump from halo stems and don’t feel like Holy Pandas. It bottoms out a little bit earlier and moves the bump to mid/mid-top.
Like the color and materials but want to customize the feel and sound? Check out our slow springs and Accessories for all your switch modding essentials.
Available in quantities of 35.

sourceText:
"You are an alchemist; make gold of that." - William Shakespeare
With the blessing of DSA Alchemy designer Chris Swires , the team at Alchemist Keyboards remastered this subtly stunning keyset in a GMK profile.
This keycap set features cool grey and beige tones representing base metals, a gold accent representing every alchemist's primary goal, and warm brown legends representing the base element of earth providing stark contrast. The colors will be matched as closely as possible to DSA Alchemy.
GMK Alchemy is offered in a robust base kit that covers standard layouts, while also including accents and a few cheeky text novelties. The Apprentice Kit supports most 40% boards (includes shorty bars), the Essense Kit offers spacebars for accent lovers, and the stunning High Alchemy Kit features deliberately agnostic legends.
Also offered is a RAMA Cap , featuring the philosopher's stone symbol, finished in brass with black infill.
Don't forget to check out the three matching GMK Alchemy Deskmats for the full alchemy treatment.

In order to meet our goal of providing an in stock mid range keyboard at an affordable price, we have adjusted our quality standards compared to our more premium keyboards. We have listed acceptable blemishes and B-Stock information below.

In general, large defects to visible faces will make a board B stock. Keyboard cases that ship with keyboards are meant to protect keyboards during shipping. These keyboard cases are made to order to fit the keyboard precisely, and are limited in quantity. As such, we do not replace keyboard cases if the keyboard case arrives damaged. name: Unified Daughterboards
sourceText:
Unified Daughterboards - C4, C5, S1
The Unified Daughterboard Project is an open source project designed to standardize the USB daughterboards used in custom keyboards, spearheaded by many community contributors such as ai03. The goal of the project is to provide standards that are easy to build upon to incentivize DIY in the keyboard hobby, while providing an easy pipeline for replacements.
Over the years, new additions to the project have been added. The current lineup consists of the S1, C4, and C5. The C4 and C5 are designed to fit into keyboards like the Bakeneko where the C3 was once used.

name: Balance Keyboard
sourceText:
The Balance Keyboard by CannonKeys
When you purchase this keyboard, you automatically qualify for our Premium Keyboard Bundle ! Take 25% off any keycap base kit on the site!
To learn more about our bundles, click here .
The Balance is a complex FRL-1800 with a knob designed by Upas to fill a gap within the keyboard hobby. The name Balance comes from the way the keyboard appears to balance on the back accent of the keyboard. Here is some background on the keyboard, as told by Upas:
One of my favorite keyboards to use is the Cypher - but when I use it, I really do miss having a knob to control volume and media. For that reason, even when doing tasks that are better suited for a numpad, I find myself using my Satisfaction75 quite frequently. This board was meant to fill that gap for me, while also playing with a new interesting side profile, considering two-tone color as a first-class design element, and integrating gasket mounting.
Specs
Typing angle: 5.5 °
Case Material: Aluminum
Mounting system: Poron gasket isolation sandwich mount
Front height: ~ 15.7mm (without feet)
PCB: Designed by Upas (with assistance from Ender) using STM32, with some ESD protection. Paired with the ai03 unified daughterboard. QMK & VIA compatible PCB. Solder only.
Plates: Black aluminum as standard, with FR4, PC and brass as optional extras
Knob: Alps encoder, CannonKeys knob comes stock, specifics below. Extra knobs in different materials and colors available.
Weight: 1.6kg unbuilt (est.)
Kit Contents
Keyboard top, bottom, top left accent, top right accent, bottom accent piece
Black aluminum plate
Balance PCB (USB-C, ESD Production)
Unified C3 Daughterboard and JST Cable
ALPS Encoder
CannonKeys Logo Knob
Poron Gaskets
Rubber feet (bumpon compatible)
Foam Carrying Case
Microfiber Cloth
Colors available
Navy top/Silver bottom, Silver top accent/Navy bottom accent, Silver CK knob *
Grey top/Lilac bottom, Lilac top accent/Grey bottom accent, Silver CK knob
Black top/Silver bottom, Silver top accent/Black bottom accent, Silver CK knob
(+$20) E-white top/Gold Alu bottom, Brass top accent, E-white bottom accent, Gold PVD brass CK knob
*In the images the navy version has a gold top accent. the group buy version will have a silver top accent.
The black/silver and white/gold versions are shown as renders and will vary slightly from what is shown.
